column1: # Subject map: which suite exercises which file, read by tests/run.sh --changed and the test audit.
# A new or moved file a suite loads gets its row in the same commit.
#   own_suite  the suite that exercises the file most directly (test file basename without .test.sh), or -.
#              - also marks a file the audit must not mutate, such as a fixture input: audit.py plan samples no mutants of it.
#   loaded_by  comma list of every suite that sources, executes, renders, copies or greps the file; includes own_suite.
# Non-goal suites are listed in loaded_by for completeness; the harness never runs them.
# Files no suite loads are absent.
